title: Open Finance
subtitle: Your banks and cards, connected through Meu Pluggy.
description: Connect your banks in Meu Pluggy and click Connect Meu Pluggy below. After you authorize access, connections are registered automatically. The service refreshes data every 24 hours; fetching here reads the latest available update.

months.label: Transaction month
months.pending: {count, plural, =0 {All imported} one {# to import} other {# to import}}

setup.title: Server configuration pending
setup.description: Configure PLUGGY_CLIENT_ID and PLUGGY_CLIENT_SECRET on the server. Never paste these credentials into a screen field.

connect.title: Connect your banks
connect.description: Your authorized banks are registered through Meu Pluggy. Up to five personal connections at the provider.
connect.syncing: Waiting for your Meu Pluggy connections. They will appear here automatically.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Add your authorized banks to list available accounts and cards.
connections.attention: This connection needs attention in Meu Pluggy.

source.title: Where to import from?
source.description: Choose the bank account or credit card you want to review.
source.emptyDescription: The preview will appear here after you choose a source and check its fi-sync destination.

sidebar.title: Connections
sidebar.description: Select an account or a card to review its transactions.

import.title: Import from {source}
import.description: Check the destination and period. Transactions are saved only after your review.

mapping.title: fi-sync destination
mapping.description: Choose where to save future imports. You can change the destination at any time; saved transactions stay in their current accounts.
mapping.editing: Choose a destination and fetch the preview. The same account can receive data from multiple banks; transactions are saved only after your confirmation.

management.title: Connected banks
management.description: Connect a bank or choose where to import the data for each account and card.
management.inactive: {count, plural, one {Show # disabled connection} other {Show # disabled connections}}

review.title: Choose and review transactions
review.description: Select the transactions to bring in, or open Review and edit on any row. Adjust the data and confirm each transaction before saving. Unselected transactions stay available for later.

existing.label: Existing transaction with the same date and amount

splits.needsPersonFirst: Choose a person above to split
splits.mismatch: The split total must match the transaction amount

empty.title: No new transactions
empty.description: Previously imported or ignored transactions do not appear again. Available history depends on the bank.

selection.count: {count, plural, one {# transaction on this page} other {# transactions on this page}}
selection.selected: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
selection.review: Review {count, plural, one {# selected} other {# selected}}
selection.markExisting: Mark {count, plural, one {# as already recorded} other {# as already recorded}}

existing.title: Mark as already recorded?
existing.description: These transactions will not be created again and stop showing here. Those with a transaction of the same date and amount in the destination are linked to it; the rest are recorded as entered by other means.
existing.linked: {count, plural, =0 {None has a matching transaction in the destination} one {# will be linked to an existing transaction} other {# will be linked to existing transactions}}
existing.unlinked: {count, plural, =0 {All have a matching transaction in the destination} one {# will be marked without a link} other {# will be marked without a link}}

create.title: Edit before saving
create.description: The bank data is shown below for reference. Edit the fields for fi-sync; your bank will not be changed. Confirming saves only this transaction.
create.remaining: {count, plural, one {# transaction in this review} other {# transactions in this review}}

toast.existing: {count, plural, one {# transaction marked as already recorded.} other {# transactions marked as already recorded.}}

widget.title: Connection was not completed
widget.description: Check the message in the Meu Pluggy window. It will stay open so you can retry or close it.

widgetLoad.title: The window did not load
widgetLoad.description: Could not load the Pluggy window. Check your connection and try again; if it persists, check whether your browser is blocking Pluggy content.

widgetDuplicate.title: A connection already exists
widgetDuplicate.description: Pluggy blocked this attempt because a connection already exists. Close the window, refresh fi-sync and open Meu Pluggy again to authorize access through the app.

widgetCredentials.title: Check your Meu Pluggy login
widgetCredentials.description: Meu Pluggy did not accept the supplied login details. You can correct them in the open window.

widgetAuthorization.title: Authorization pending
widgetAuthorization.description: Complete authorization in the Meu Pluggy window. Connections will appear after confirmation.

widgetToken.title: The connection session expired
widgetToken.description: Close the Pluggy window and click Connect Meu Pluggy again to start a new session.

widgetConnector.title: Connector unavailable
widgetConnector.description: Pluggy did not make the MeuPluggy connector available for this application. Check that connector 200 is enabled in the Dashboard.

stale.title: Transaction updated
stale.description: The bank changed this transaction. Close the review, fetch the data again and check it before importing.

configuration.title: Incomplete configuration
configuration.description: Configure the Meu Pluggy credentials on the server.

provider.title: Could not query Meu Pluggy
provider.description: Check your connection and authorization in Meu Pluggy and try again.

access.title: Access unavailable
access.description: This integration is only available to the authorized user.

mapping.title: Invalid destination
mapping.description: Choose an active account with the same currency and type, and an active card belonging to it.

mappingChanged.title: Destination changed
mappingChanged.description: The destination or period changed during this review. Close the review and fetch the preview again to check where to save.

duplicate.title: Possible duplicate
duplicate.description: A transaction with the same date and amount exists. Link it below or create it as a new transaction if they are different.

pending.title: Pending transaction
pending.description: Wait for confirmation from the bank before importing.

payment.title: Invoice payment
payment.description: Register the payment on the invoices screen or link an existing payment.

currency.title: Unsupported currency
currency.description: This initial integration only imports amounts in Brazilian reais, without currency conversion.

invoice.title: Check the invoice
invoice.description: Provide valid closing and due dates for the destination invoice.

busy.title: Import in progress
busy.description: Wait a moment and try again.
